race.comment: POLYMER (4) kept racing so well in his first real preparation. Excellent form here saw him head to a Highway where he closed off strongly. Has to be a big chance. EX WIFE (2) has been close up for all his recent efforts. Has been giving away starts and from the draw, might do so again. HIGHLAND FORCE (6) put two together before being run down late. Gets some weight relief here and can bounce back. A TOUCH FROM FAYT (11) has been knocking on the door, including a last start fifth over 1120m at Lismore when only 1.5 lengths from the winner. Well placed and can give this a shake. THE LUPERCAL (9) next best.
